title: Choosing the Geometry: valuations, norms, and contours
summary: We develop a general framework for constructing pseudometrics on objects of Abelian categories using valuations, which assign non-negative costs to morphisms. Specializing to finitely presented vector space representations of the poset $[0,\infty)^\ell$, a natural setting for multiparameter persistence modules, we show that a large class of these distances is governed by contours, right-continuous lax actions of $[0,\infty)$ on the parameter poset.
